source_control_cause: P2PCallPanel derived width.max=720*(960/720)=960 before the first real window frame. The true16:9 source was then downscaled to960x540. The call engine repeated this calculation; both paths corrected in664435a.
regression_classification: Inherited derivation also present in0.4.2; not proven to be introduced by0.4.3 native capture

followup.observed: Preview still960x540 despite removing derived early width. The original cause explains the explicit old clamp but not all browser default/constraint negotiation. No complete fix established.
